verdict.rationale: Elicit's API is explicitly versioned by URL path: the OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec documents v2 at /api/v2 and notes a distinct older v1 API. The deprecation half of the story is absent, so only roughly half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation or sunset policy and timeline for v1, deprecated flags in the spec, an API changelog, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: This reference documents **v2**, with production base URL https://elicit.com/api/v2
